tools.name: list_businesses
tools.description: List the five fictional business fixtures and categories in the PIP chatbot evaluation pack.

tools.name: list_cases
tools.description: Browse fictional evaluation prompts with optional business, category and critical filters. Paginated; expected answers are returned by get_case.

tools.name: get_case
tools.description: Retrieve a specific fictional evaluation case, expected response, and its source facts. No chatbot is executed.

tools.name: estimate_monthly_cost
tools.description: Estimate a monthly cost from explicitly supplied base, included usage, additional pack size and price. Amounts are integer cents; no live vendor prices.
